purpose: Detailed protocol implementation; timing recovery was subsequently amended as documented in timing-procedure-amendment.json before any timing analysis.

matching.stop: first point within tolerance; otherwise closest tested point
matching.search: bounded secant with interval contraction; cached probes reused

timing_analysis.unit: images stratified by content category, then blocks and repetitions paired across codecs
timing_analysis.point_estimate: ratio of sums of per-image median milliseconds
timing_analysis.confidence: 95% percentile; Bonferroni 6 for each reference and matching mode

quality_sensitivity: Report full five-point BD-rate and omission of each interior point separately; sensitivity is diagnostic, not a confidence interval.

common_speed_table.selection: all eight codecs match target and actual WebP M6 bytes within 2% per image
common_speed_table.scope: one common subset for all rows; report coverage; no substitution for full-corpus results
common_speed_table.confidence: 95% percentile; optional Bonferroni 14 comparisons (7 alternatives x2 operations)

timing_interference_guard.policy: Wait before timing; repeat all codecs at one image/mode/level within a block on any before/after interference observation. Checkpoint other complete operating-point groups. No external process is interrupted. Short-lived jobs can escape sampling.
